name: Make Space!

pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.label: Pick a space
pick.heading: Pick an empty space and give it a new life
lead: Every city is full of space that nobody uses: the department store that closed, the car park that’s empty all night, the old phone box that hasn’t had a phone in it since 2005.
Choose a space that’s empty, half-used or forgotten, and turn it into something people would queue for. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *Bonus points if it’s in Berlin.*
pick.note: This isn’t a planning application. Some ideas will make total sense and some will need a lot of imagination and a very relaxed Bauamt. Both are welcome.

shelf.head: Big and odd
items: A church with twelve people in it on Sundays

rows: Which empty or forgotten space are you rescuing?
The smell, the dust, the pigeons, what the neighbours say about it…
A shop, a home, a club, a school, something completely mad?
Who comes first? Neighbours, tourists, students, someone else?
What stays exactly as it was, so people remember what it used to be?
Who do you get to talk about it, and where?

values.now: Concrete, puddles that never dry, a smell of old petrol, and a ticket machine that has hated everyone since 1994.
values.idea: Level Six: every floor is something different. Floor one is a flea market, floor three is a padel court, floor five is an open-air cinema, and the roof is a beer garden with the best sunset in Neukölln.
values.who: Neighbours who have complained about the car park for thirty years, and anyone who has ever wanted a rooftop bar that doesn’t charge fourteen euros for a cocktail.
values.keep: The ramps. You go up on the old car ramp, ideally on an e-scooter, which is finally a good use for one.
values.promote: A secret party on the roof on opening night, announced only by fake parking tickets left on people’s bikes.
